description: F3 long (ledger): the silver chest is moved to the cellar at 60; the break is at 72.

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: Snow piles against the inn's shutters.

transcript.speaker: Brann
transcript.text: Brann carries the silver chest down to the cellar and hides it behind the wine racks.

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: Upstairs, the common room fills with drovers.

transcript.speaker: Ilka
transcript.text: Ilka serves stew and counts coins at the bar.

transcript.speaker: Brann
transcript.text: Brann comes back up and wipes his hands on his apron.

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: A drover starts a song about a lost ewe.

transcript.speaker: Brann
transcript.text: "I'll bake at first light," Brann says.

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: The fire pops and a log settles.

transcript.speaker: Ilka
transcript.text: Ilka laughs at a drover's joke.

transcript.speaker: Brann
transcript.text: Brann stacks clean bowls behind the bar.

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: The drovers drift off to their rooms one by one.

transcript.speaker: Brann
transcript.text: Brann locks the front door and blows out the lamps.
